title: An earlier year a 2025 Social Security lump-sum payment is attributable to

earlier_year.description: The earlier taxable year this row's part of the 2025 lump-sum payment is for, as the benefit statement shows it. Between 1984 and 2024: a part for years before 1984 is not taxed and is not in box 3, and a year that is not earlier than 2025 is not a prior taxable year under IRC 86(e)(1)(A). The year picks the worksheet the engine refigures with — Publication 915 Worksheet 2 for 1994 and later, Worksheet 3 for 1993 and earlier — and both read the same answers on this row.

lump_sum_portion_cents.description: The part of the 2025 lump-sum payment that is for this earlier year (Publication 915, Worksheet 2 and 3, line 1). Required. It is added to that year's own benefits and subtracted from this year's box 5 total.

benefits_received_cents.description: The benefits received in the earlier year itself — box 5 of that year's statement (Publication 915, Worksheet 2 and 3, line 1, first term). Required; 0 if none.

adjusted_gross_income_cents.description: The earlier year's adjusted gross income (Publication 915, Worksheet 2 and 3, line 3). Required.

exclusions_cents.description: The earlier year's exclusions and adjustments added back (Publication 915, Worksheet 2 and 3, line 4). Required; 0 if none.

tax_exempt_interest_cents.description: The earlier year's tax-exempt interest (Publication 915, Worksheet 2 and 3, line 5). Required; 0 if none.

taxable_benefits_reported_cents.description: The benefits already taxed for the earlier year — what that year's return reported (Publication 915, Worksheet 2 line 7, Worksheet 3 line 7). Required; 0 if none.

filed_jointly.description: Whether the earlier year's return was a joint return. Required: it decides the base amount the refigure uses.

mfs_lived_with_spouse.description: Whether the earlier year's return was married filing separately AND the filers lived together at some time that year. Required: that combination drops the base amount to 0 for the refigure.
